At Board, we power financial and operational planning solutions for the world’s best brands. Thousands of enterprises use our technology to optimize resources, drive growth, and ensure profitability. With advanced analytics and forecasting, plus AI-driven insights, customers transform complex, real-time data into actionable intelligence.What’s been key to our success? Our people—we value everyone’s unique perspective and energy they bring to the organization. We collaborate openly across teams and borders. We embrace a growth mindset to get results. And we celebrate shared success as goals and milestones are achieved.Ready to join a team where innovation meets collaboration? If you're driven by bold ideas and a customer-centric mentality, your next adventure starts here!We're seeking a bright, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented Associate Product Manager to join our dynamic Product Management team in Chiasso. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated individual to contribute to the evolution of our cutting-edge unified platform. As an Associate Product Manager, you will work closely with experienced Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to understand market needs, define product requirements, and help bring innovative solutions to our customers. You will play a crucial role in shaping the future of our product and driving its success in the global market.
• Responsibilities: - Market and User Research: Assist in conducting market research, analyzing industry trends, and gathering user feedback to identify opportunities and unmet needs. -
• Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear and concise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. - Product Planning and Strategy: Support the Product Management team in defining the product vision, roadmap, and prioritization of features. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure successful product delivery and adoption. - Product Documentation: Assist in creating and maintaining product documentation, including user guides, release notes, and internal training materials. - Competitive Analysis: Monitor and analyze competitor products and activities to identify strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities for differentiation. - Performance Monitoring: Track and analyze product performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and inform future product decisions. - Product Evangelism: Support the communication of product value propositions and benefits to internal and external stakeholders. - Agile Participation: Actively participate in agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
• Qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. - Previous experience in product management, business analysis, or a related role in the software industry. - Experience in CPM/EPM project implementations - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish. - An understanding of software development processes and agile methodologies. - Passion for technology and a keen interest in planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analytics solutions. - Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team. - Highly organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. - Familiarity with data analysis tools and techniques is a plus. The RFx Proposal Manager partners closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Product, Legal, Security, Finance, Compliance, and executive stakeholders to coordinate complex proposal responses, develop compelling messaging, and ensure submissions are compliant, accurate, and aligned with deal strategy. The ideal candidate combines strong proposal management expertise, excellent communication skills, and a strategic mindset, while leveraging AI-enabled tools and proposal automation technologies to improve proposal efficiency, quality, and consistency. ## Key
• Responsibilities 1. Proposal Strategy & Delivery - Lead the end-to-end development of RFP, RFI, and RFQ responses for enterprise software opportunities. - Analyze solicitation documents to identify technical, functional, security, and commercial requirements. - Develop proposal plans, compliance matrices, timelines, and SME assignments. - Coordinate cross-functional teams to gather inputs and ensure timely completion of proposal components. - Ensure all submissions are accurate, compliant, compelling, and delivered on schedule. 2. Proposal Content & Knowledge Management (AI-enabled) - Develop and maintain a centralized proposal knowledge library to improve response consistency and reuse. - Implement and manage AI-enabled tools for proposal content discovery, tagging, and reuse. - Maintain governance of proposal content, including metadata, version control, and content accuracy. - Leverage AI-assisted drafting and summarization tools to improve response development efficiency. - Analyze proposal trends and feedback to continuously improve proposal assets and templates. 4. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner with Sales teams to understand deal strategy and competitive positioning. - Work with Pre-Sales and Solutions Consulting to validate solution design and technical responses. - Collaborate with Legal, Security, IT, and Compliance teams to ensure responses meet regulatory and contractual requirements. - Coordinate executive involvement in strategic pursuits where appropriate. 5. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement - Improve global proposal processes, templates, and governance frameworks. - Leverage proposal automation platforms to streamline response development. - Track proposal performance metrics including win rate, response cycle time, and stakeholder feedback. - Contribute to the development of a Proposal Center of Excellence supporting global sales teams. ## Required
• Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Finance, or a related field - 4–8 years of experience in proposal management within enterprise software, SaaS, or technology environments - Proven experience supporting complex enterprise RFP responses - Strong ability to translate technical and financial concepts into clear business messaging - Excellent project management and stakeholder coordination skills - Experience with proposal automation platforms or AI-assisted content tools - Exceptional written communication and organizational skills ## Preferred
• Qualifications - Experience in Enterprise Planning, EPM, FP&A, Consolidation, Supply Chain Planning, or Analytics software - Familiarity with enterprise procurement and buying processes - APMP certification or equivalent proposal management training - Experience managing proposal content libraries or knowledge management systems - Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce ## Key Competencies - Strategic thinking and commercial awareness - Executive-level written communication - Cross-functional collaboration and influence - Strong attention to detail and compliance rigor - Ability to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously - Digital and AI fluency - Structured problem solving and organization ## Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Join a company that believes in the added value of diversity, inclusion, and belonging.
